EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.mobileProductionMeaning: STORE_MVP=ON — advanced surfaces (buyPrice, priceSpread, trendPrediction, newsSentiment, ytStats, watchlist, pushAlerts, premium) are HIDDEN on the mobile production (AAB/APK) build. Already explicit in eas.json build.production.env (and inherited by production-apk) — no change needed.
EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.webProductionMeaning: As of the current origin/main HEAD, EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP is still NOT explicitly injected into the Web Production build command, so src/config/releaseFlags.ts's unset-value fallback (Platform.OS !== 'web') resolves it to OFF on web — the full feature set is shown. This is the exact asymmetry the user correction in DIC-1401 flags as a violation of the single-codebase/same-progress rule.
EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.reason: User-corrected policy (DIC-1401 follow-up): Web Production MUST explicitly set EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP=1 (matching mobile) instead of relying on the unset-value web fallback, and that fallback itself (Platform.OS !== 'web' fail-open-on-web) must be removed so a missing/blank/invalid define fails closed on every Production surface, not just native. The deploy-profile half of this fix (explicit `EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP=1` in Web Production's vercel.json buildCommand) is prepared in a separate, NOT-YET-MERGED PR against `main` (see followUp) — CI/CD scope, gated on CR+QA+PM per the standard promotion flow because it changes live Production behaviour. The runtime fallback code fix in src/config/releaseFlags.ts is explicitly out of Mac-Copilot's CI/CD-only scope and is assigned to Mac-Claude at the DEV gate.
EXPO_PUBLIC_STORE_MVP.followUp: 1) Web Production vercel.json define change: prepared PR against `main` (opened by Mac-Copilot, NOT merged — merge only after CR+QA+PM acceptance, since flipping this define changes what Web Production currently shows). 2) src/config/releaseFlags.ts resolveStoreMvp() unset-fallback removal (web must fail-closed to STORE_MVP=ON like native, not fail-open to OFF): tracked for Mac-Claude at the DEV implementation gate (DIC-1380 W3 DEV), not implemented in this CI/CD-scoped ticket. Once both land, update this ledger entry's parity to 'synced' and re-run npm run test:release-flags-parity to confirm.
